pages.text: With the basic understanding of Dustology, you are able to enter a new stage and explore a new topic: Ashology. $(br2)A $(l:ash/centrifuge)Centrifuge$(/l) would be very useful for you. It provides you a new way to get dust by isolating some materials. Also, some advanced materials requires $(l:ash/centrifuge)Centrifuge$(/l). $(br)Finally, upgrade your $(l:dust/integrated_block)Integrated Block$(/l) to the final level, you would be able to create almost everything with it.
